Subject: Sponsorship Proposal: KIN Hub's Innovation Pipeline — Kogi State
 
Dear NITDA Team,

I'm reaching out on behalf of Kogi Innovation Hub (KINHUB) to invite the National Information Technology Development Agency (NITDA) to sponsor our upcoming lineup of programmes — KINHACK (a multi-university hackathon), a two-month Incubation Programme, and our flagship Kogi Tech Week.

This pipeline is a practical, on-the-ground vehicle for several of NITDA's own priorities: growing Nigeria's pool of digitally skilled youth, extending IT development beyond the usual hubs into underserved states, and cultivating homegrown startups aligned with the National Digital Economy Policy and Strategy. Sponsorship would let NITDA introduce its own programmes, certifications, and initiatives (such as the Nigeria Digital Trustmark and its various training schemes) directly to a concentrated audience of student innovators and founders in Kogi State.

It also offers NITDA a visible, reportable example of federal-level digital economy policy being implemented at the state level, in partnership with the Kogi State Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology and KICTDA, who we are already in engagement to be as Host Partners.

We've attached our sponsorship deck, which outlines tiers and benefits in detail. We'd welcome the opportunity to discuss this further at your convenience.

Thank you for considering this, and we look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
ItopaKing David
Strategy & Content Lead
Kogi Innovation Hub (KINHUB)

INVITATION TO ISACA LAGOS CHAPTER 30TH ANNIVERSARY

 

On behalf of the ISACA Lagos Chapter of ISACA Nigeria, we write with great honour and deep respect to request your presence at ISACA Lagos 30th anniversary. The ceremony will be graced by the presence of the Global CEO of ISACA, who will be visiting Nigeria to mark a historic milestone — the 30th anniversary of ISACA in Nigeria.  Lagos is the cradle of ISACA in Nigeria before the expansion to Abuja, Port Harcourt and Ibadan.

 

ISACA Lagos is a network of skilled, experienced, and committed professionals affiliated with ISACA Global (headquartered in Chicago, USA), a globally respected body focused on IT governance, cybersecurity, audit, risk assurance, and emerging technologies. With over 200 chapters in 80+ countries, the Lagos Chapter is the 3rd-largest in Africa and the largest GRC professional association in Nigeria, with active members across Banking, Public Service, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Public Sector, Health, and Hospitality. Over the past 30 years in Nigeria, we represent a shared journey of capacity building, policy advocacy, and professional excellence across public and private sectors.

 

The dinner event will be held Friday 21st August 2026 at Admiralty Conference Centre, Naval Dockyard Limited, Ahmadu Bello Way, Victoria Island. Lagos at 5.00pm.

Dear Director General,

I am writing to you on behalf of the Lagos Youth Development Institute (LYDI), a government-supported institution focused on developing innovative, future-ready young leaders across Nigeria.

We are officially preparing for the flagship Lagos Youth Leadership Conference (LYLC) 2026, taking place in Lagos under the central theme: “The Power Equation: How Youth and Institutions Shape the Future of Governance.”

Given the National Information Technology Development Agency (NITDA)'s outstanding track record of driving digital literacy, policy transformation, and technology leadership, as well as its direct alignment with national digital talent development through initiatives such as the 3 Million Technical Talent (3MTT) Programme, your organization is a natural fit for this platform.

LYLC 2026 will serve as a high-impact space, bringing together top policymakers, corporate executives, diplomatic missions, and over 5,000 highly skilled young professionals. We are establishing this platform not just as a standard event, but as a collaborative space to co-create actionable policy white papers, expand digital public infrastructure, and build long-term talent pipelines.

We would like to explore inviting the National Information Technology Development Agency (NITDA) as a Principal Strategic Partner for the conference. This alignment provides a clear opportunity to position LYLC as a priority hub for South-West engagement on national digital talent frameworks while reinforcing NITDA's leadership in advancing Nigeria's digital economy and technology ecosystem.

We have attached our comprehensive Partnership Architecture Brief for your review. Are you available for a brief, 10-minute introductory call this Thursday at 2:00 PM WAT or Friday at 11:00 AM WAT to discuss how we can align this platform with your 2026 strategic objectives?

Thank you for your time, leadership, and consideration.

Warm regards,

Ruth Itepu
Head of Partnerships & Sponsorship
Lagos Youth Leadership Conference (LYLC) 2026
Lagos Youth Development Institute (LYDI)

The Director-General / CEO

Dear Sir,

SUBJECT: INVITATION FOR STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP, FINANCIAL COLLABORATION, AND SUSTAINABILITY SUPPORT FOR THE NATIONAL YOUTH SUMMIT ON NATION BUILDING AND ECONOMIC RESILIENCE

I hope this letter finds you well.

On behalf of the New Horizon Trust Life Care Foundation (NHTLCF), in collaboration with the Congress of Nigerian Youths (CONYO), I am honored to formally invite the National Information Technology Development Agency (NITDA) to partner with us as an Official Strategic, Financial, and Ecosystem Partner for the National Youth Summit on Nation Building and Economic Resilience, scheduled to hold on Saturday, 24 October 2026, at the Ikeja Youth Centre, Ikeja, Lagos, Nigeria.

The theme of this year’s summit is:

“Youth Leadership, Enterprise and Innovation for Sustainable Development.”

The summit will convene over 500 participants, including university students, young entrepreneurs, startup founders, software developers, innovators, policymakers, investors, development partners, and emerging business leaders from across Nigeria. It is designed to promote meaningful dialogue, strategic collaboration, innovation, and practical solutions that will empower young people to contribute to national development and economic resilience.

As the Federal Government’s foremost agency responsible for driving Nigeria’s digital economy through information technology development, innovation, and digital transformation, NITDA has consistently championed policies and initiatives that promote digital literacy, technology entrepreneurship, innovation ecosystems, local software development, and capacity building for Nigerian youths.

Your Agency’s strategic mandate aligns seamlessly with the objectives of this summit, particularly our commitment to equipping young Nigerians with the knowledge, skills, networks, and opportunities required to thrive in an increasingly digital and innovation-driven economy.

In view of this alignment, we respectfully seek NITDA’s partnership through institutional collaboration, technical support, financial sponsorship, and ecosystem engagement to ensure the successful delivery and long-term sustainability of this national initiative.

We would be deeply honored to welcome NITDA as an Official Strategic, Financial, and Ecosystem Partner, leveraging your institutional leadership to expand the summit’s impact and strengthen youth participation in Nigeria’s digital transformation agenda.

As an Official Strategic and Financial Partner, NITDA will have the opportunity to:

  • Receive official recognition as a Core Institutional and Financial Partner of the National Youth Summit.
  • Showcase NITDA’s flagship digital economy initiatives, innovation programmes, startup support schemes, digital literacy projects, and funding opportunities through a branded exhibition pavilion.
  • Deliver goodwill remarks or participate in high-level panel discussions on digital transformation, innovation, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, entrepreneurship, and emerging technologies.
  • Engage directly with over 500 young innovators, software developers, startup founders, researchers, and technology entrepreneurs from across Nigeria.
  • Identify and connect with promising startups and digital talents for future incubation, mentorship, grants, and capacity-building programmes.
  • Strengthen awareness of NITDA’s strategic initiatives through extensive nationwide media coverage, digital campaigns, summit publications, and event branding.
  • Demonstrate NITDA’s continued commitment to youth empowerment, digital inclusion, innovation, and sustainable national development.

We believe this partnership presents a unique opportunity to further advance NITDA’s strategic objectives while contributing meaningfully to the development of Nigeria’s next generation of technology leaders, innovators, entrepreneurs, and digital change-makers.

Upon your favorable consideration, we will be pleased to forward our comprehensive Summit Proposal, Partnership Prospectus, Sponsorship Packages, Detailed Budget, and Event Brief for your executive review.

We sincerely appreciate your time and consideration and look forward to the opportunity of partnering with the National Information Technology Development Agency to inspire, digitally empower, and economically position the next generation of Nigerian innovators and technology leaders.

Please accept the assurances of our highest esteem.

Yours faithfully,

Amb. Paul Ogunkoya
Executive Director
New Horizon Trust Life Care Foundation (NHTLCF)

In collaboration with the Congress of Nigerian Youths (CONYO)

Subject: Partnership Request: NITDA Capacity Building & Certification for World Merit Katsina Team
 
Dear Director-General,

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing on behalf of the World Merit Katsina State Council, a network of young change-makers dedicated to driving sustainable capacity building, digital inclusion, and youth leadership across Katsina State.

We highly commend the National Information Technology Development Agency (NITDA) for its strategic drive to achieve 70% digital literacy in Nigeria. To support this national roadmap at the grassroots level, our council is currently deploying The Bridge Initiative, a digital literacy campaign aiming to equip over 1,000 secondary school students across Katsina State with essential digital skills.

To maximize the quality and institutional alignment of our deployment, we want to formally propose a Train-the-Trainer capacity-building partnership with NITDA for our core executive team and volunteer facilitators in Katsina.

Specifically, we request that NITDA provides a specialized, certified digital training program (covering tracks like Digital Literacy, Product Management, or Data Skills) for our team members. This will ensure that our facilitators are fully grounded in NITDA’s standardized curriculum frameworks.

Upon completion, our NITDA-certified team will directly step down this knowledge to thousands of underserved students across public and private schools in the state. By empowering the World Merit leadership team, NITDA will be embedding a highly skilled, sustainable ecosystem of digital ambassadors directly into Katsina’s grassroots communities.

We would highly appreciate an introductory meeting with your team, regional or state representatives on your convenient date and time to discuss how we can structure this training cohort.

Thank you for your continuous leadership and dedication to transforming Nigeria's digital landscape.

Warm regards,
World Merit Katsina State.

Delegates Dining Room

United Nations Headquarters, New York, US

 

 

Dear Madam/Sir,

 

With eight weeks to go until Digital@UNGA 2026, preparations are well underway for what promises to be one of the most exciting editions of our flagship event to date. We are also approaching the registration deadline of 21 August 2026 and encourage you to secure your place early.

 

On 21 September, leaders from governments, the United Nations, the private sector, academia, civil society and youth will gather at United Nations Headquarters in New York to explore how we can Build a Digit'all Future Together.

 

This year's programme will feature inspiring speakers, dynamic conversations, real-world stories of digital innovation and inclusion, the Digital@UNGA Awards, and new opportunities to connect with partners and changemakers from around the world.

 

Whether you are working to expand connectivity, harness AI responsibly, strengthen digital public infrastructure, or advance digital skills and inclusion, Digital@UNGA offers a unique opportunity to exchange ideas, build partnerships and help shape the future of digital cooperation.

▶ Watch the teaser video

 

Register today to secure your place at Digital@UNGA 2026*. As places are filling quickly, we encourage you to complete your registration by the registration deadline of 21 August 2026. We also encourage you to share this invitation with colleagues and partners who may wish to join this important global conversation. For further information, please contact: DigitalUNGA@itu.int

 

*Please note that participants are responsible for making their own travel arrangements, including visas, accommodation, and transportation. The organizers are not in a position to issue visa support letters.

 

We look forward to welcoming you to New York.

 

Yours faithfully,

The Digital@UNGA Secretariat

This year's programme will feature inspiring speakers, dynamic conversations, real-world stories of digital innovation and inclusion, the Digital@UNGA Awards, and new opportunities to connect with partners and changemakers from around the world.

 

Whether you are working to expand connectivity, harness AI responsibly, strengthen digital public infrastructure, or advance digital skills and inclusion, Digital@UNGA offers a unique opportunity to exchange ideas, build partnerships and help shape the future of digital cooperation.
